baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 2-6: caused mountain motion followed by the earth becoming exposed.
baseline_models.mechanism: The normally elevated, solid relief is forcibly displaced, removing occlusion and turning the lower terrain into one open field.

activation_trace.role: This removal or expulsion branch makes caused motion function as clearance of the terrain.
The elevated solid mass supplies the obstructing relief that is cleared.
The lower surface opposite the sky becomes the continuous substrate revealed by clearance.
The uncovered wide-space branch turns visibility into an unshielded spatial condition.

changed_reading.before: Mountains travel and the earth happens to be visible.
changed_reading.after: Mountain motion is a clearing operation that unroofs the lower world into a single exposed field.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Words 7-11: gathering them while leaving not one of them behind.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispersed population is driven to one destination, and the negative construction closes every possible remainder at the individual level.

activation_trace.role: Gathering with directed driving supplies convergence toward a common destination.
Leaving something behind supplies the remainder operation that the negation cancels.
The negative-polarity branch makes the cancellation exhaustive across every eligible person.

changed_reading.before: A very large crowd is assembled.
changed_reading.after: Every individual is extracted from dispersion and delivered to one destination with zero human remainder.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The full sequence: fixed masses move, hidden ground appears, and dispersed humans are concentrated.
baseline_models.mechanism: Three coordinated state reversals abolish ordinary spatial security: the immovable moves, the covered becomes visible, and the mobile multitude can no longer remain dispersed.

activation_trace.role: Hard ground that stops penetration supplies the focus image's normal condition of fixity.
Caused travel reverses the mountain's resistant fixity.
Emergence after concealment supplies the second reversal from hidden to manifest.
Directed gathering supplies the third reversal from human dispersion to concentration.

changed_reading.before: The verse lists separate end-time events.
changed_reading.after: The events form one engineered reversal of spatial statuses that eliminates stability, cover, and dispersion together.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier earth first bears growth, then its cover becomes brittle residue and is wind-scattered; the focus scales that stripping logic upward by removing even the mountains and exposing the substrate.

activation_trace.role: Productive ground supplies the initially clothed surface whose later bareness becomes consequential.
Dry broken vegetation supplies the disintegrated surface cover.
Wind-winnowing supplies the removal process that carries the broken cover away.
Removal or expulsion extends surface stripping to the mountains.
The elevated solid mass is the final and largest layer removed.
Emergence from concealment is the resulting condition of the stripped earth.

structural_cues: 18:45 moves from earth-grown cover to broken residue scattered away; 18:47 repeats the earth after mountain removal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: vegetal cover is broken and dispersed before mountains are displaced and earth is exposed. Reader arrow: both sequences instantiate stripping at different scales. Alternative: the two scenes may only juxtapose impermanence rather than share a physical process.

changed_reading.before: The exposed earth results only from a sudden topographic event.
changed_reading.after: The scene is the terminal scale of a stripping sequence: growth-cover, debris, and finally relief itself are removed until only substrate remains.

context_deltas.mechanism: The bare field becomes a presentation surface: gathering is not mere crowding but visible arrangement in a level line, with acquired distinctions reset by the return to first-created condition.

activation_trace.role: Open uncovered space supplies the presentation ground.
Directed gathering delivers the population onto that ground.
Bringing something out for inspection turns the assembly into a public presentation.
Alignment on an even line supplies the assembly's ordered geometry.
Origination supplies the reset condition under which acquired rank no longer organizes the rows.

structural_cues: The focus's exposed earth and total gathering are immediately followed by display, row formation, and return as at first creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: an uncovered field, total gathering, display, rows, and first creation occur in sequence. Reader arrow: clearance enables inspectable and comparable array. Alternative: row formation may describe order without implying the field was cleared for that purpose.

changed_reading.before: All people are collected somewhere on the changed earth.
changed_reading.after: The earth is cleared into an inspection plane on which every person is publicly arrayed under a reset of worldly distinctions.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same non-omission logic governs two inventories: no person remains outside the gathering, and no deed remains outside enumeration and presence.

activation_trace.role: Directed collection supplies the complete inventory of persons.
The negated leaving-behind operation closes the person inventory.
Exhaustive negation resolves completeness down to every person.
The repeated leaving-behind operation transfers the same completeness test to deeds.
Exhaustive counting supplies item-by-item closure of the deed inventory.
Presence and witnessed nearness make recorded deeds co-present with their doers.
The second exhaustive individual term keeps adjudication person-specific.

structural_cues: The focus's negated leaving of any person is echoed by the book's negated leaving of anything small or great, followed by deeds found present.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the same leave-nothing frame governs persons and recorded acts, with acts then present. Reader arrow: the two exhaustive inventories are synchronized for audit. Alternative: the repetition may emphasize completeness independently without specifying a single audit mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The gathering is exhaustive only in population.
changed_reading.after: Each gathered person is paired with an equally exhaustive, present inventory of action; neither agent nor act can remain off-field.

context_deltas.mechanism: Total bodily co-presence does not restore protective relations: claimed partners do not answer, a destructive separator stands between, the destination becomes visible, and no turning route remains.

activation_trace.role: Directed gathering supplies physical co-presence.
Individuality within the totality preserves each person's solitary exposure.
Claimed partnership supplies the expected rescue relation.
The absent verbal response marks failure of that relation at the point of appeal.
Separation and severance convert togetherness into relational distance.
A barrier between parties gives the failed relation a spatial form.
Direct sight makes the terminal encounter perceptually unavoidable.
The unavailable turning-away branch closes the last evasive route.

structural_cues: 18:52 runs from appeal to nonresponse to a barrier; 18:53 runs from sight of the destination to failure to find a way of turning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: everyone is gathered, partners fail to answer, separation is imposed, and no diversion is found. Reader arrow: physical convergence intensifies rather than cures relational isolation. Alternative: partner failure and route failure may concern only cultic reliance and punishment, not the geometry of gathering.

changed_reading.before: Universal gathering implies an undifferentiated collective crowd.
changed_reading.after: Everyone is physically together yet individually unrescued; the assembly is maximal co-presence combined with severed support and no exit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier refusal works through turning away, forgetting, protective covering, and sensory weight; the focus reverses that regime by making the field visible and every person externally present.

activation_trace.role: Direct perception supplies the focus's compulsory visibility.
Disclosure after concealment supplies the reversal's outward state.
Turning one's side away supplies deliberate perceptual refusal.
Loss from remembrance supplies internal removal of what was done.
A protective cover supplies the cognitive enclosure opposed by external disclosure.
Auditory heaviness completes the earlier regime of blocked reception.

structural_cues: 18:57 accumulates turning away, forgetting, heart-coverings, and ear-weight against the focus's seeing and exposure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: refusal is described through blocked memory and perception, while the focus exposes land and gathers every person. Reader arrow: external disclosure defeats the earlier concealment strategy. Alternative: the coverings may describe a settled incapacity rather than a strategy reversed by the landscape scene.

changed_reading.before: The earth is physically visible after the mountains move.
changed_reading.after: Physical exposure also stages the defeat of evasion: what was turned from, forgotten, or enclosed becomes an unavoidable external field of presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus day is the expiry of granted delay: an appointed time arrives, inhabited refuges follow the same timed destruction pattern, and even mountain shelter is displaced before universal convergence.

activation_trace.role: A severe event embodied as a day supplies the terminal time boundary.
Entering mountain country supplies a potential refuge that the focus makes unstable.
Removal or expulsion makes the potential refuge unavailable.
Acceleration supplies the timing option explicitly withheld before the deadline.
A promise fixed to time or place identifies the delayed event as an appointment.
Flight to safety supplies the refuge option that is denied.
A settlement as gathered population supplies the inhabited shelter subjected to the pattern.
The paired destruction occurrences supply the realized endpoint of the appointment.
The repeated fixed appointment turns prior town destruction into a temporal analogue for the focus day.

structural_cues: 18:58 contrasts non-acceleration with an appointment and no refuge; 18:59 repeats appointment for destroyed settlements.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: punishment is delayed to an appointment, refuge then fails, and settlements have timed destruction. Reader arrow: the focus day is delay expiring, while mountain removal gives temporal closure a spatial form. Alternative: failed refuge need not identify the mountains as shelter, and town appointments may be analogy rather than mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The day is an unspecified future catastrophe.
changed_reading.after: The day is a matured deadline: reprieve ends, inhabited and topographic refuges lose efficacy, and every person is brought in.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a crop-residue branch inside a human-gathering verb. It remains anchored by the focus's earth, gathering, and zero remainder plus 18:45's broken, scattered vegetation. Render it only as a material harvest analogy, not as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Words 5-11: exposed earth, gathering, and no remainder.

activation_trace.role: Broken dry growth supplies the field's post-growth material state.
Winnowing by wind supplies removal of loose residue.
The post-harvest remainder branch supplies the odd gleaning image for the human gathering.
Negated residue left behind makes the imagined gleaning total.
The ground itself supplies the field on which the material analogy operates.

changed_reading.before: People are assembled on bare terrain.
changed_reading.after: The sequence admits a contained harvest image: growth is winnowed, persons are wholly gleaned, and no human residue remains on the exposed field.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the mountain term into its branch for eminent communal figures. It remains anchored by explicit mountain displacement, individual exposure, and nearby failed patrons and helpers. Downstream prose should mark it as a social analogy beneath the literal topography, not identify the mountains outright with leaders.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Mountain displacement followed by open exposure and the inclusion of every individual.

activation_trace.role: Eminent communal figures compared to mountains supply the possible social superstructure.
Displacement or expulsion removes that superstructure from its settled position.
Open exposure supplies the common field left after hierarchy is removed.
Protective loyalty and support supply the patronage relation that proves unreliable.
A strengthening helper supplies the support role explicitly refused in the surrounding sequence.
Individual singularity leaves each person exposed after support structures are leveled.

changed_reading.before: Only geological masses are displaced before the human gathering.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social resonance, monumental patrons and supports are displaced so every person appears without hierarchical shelter on the common field.

strongest_changes: Mountain motion becomes clearance that turns the earth into an exposed presentation and audit field.
Zero human remainder is paired with zero deed remainder, synchronizing persons and actions for inspection.
Universal co-presence intensifies individual isolation because support relations and escape routes fail.
The focus day becomes the expiry of delayed appointment, with settlement and topographic refuge losing efficacy.
summary.what_was_special: The packet linked macro-topographic stripping to ecological winnowing, public array, exhaustive record, and failed refuge while preserving harvest and social-leveling images as qualified outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The ecological stripping sequence may be an analogy of impermanence rather than a shared physical mechanism.
The link between mountain removal and loss of refuge is inferred rather than stated.
The harvest and social-support readings depend on branch-distant images and should remain exploratory.
